rationale: Restore model11 room-face discovery and acceptance: retain exact connected source paths and existing T-node dependencies, intersect finite sides, and consume only explicitly selected identical unhosted duplicate atoms. Real HA E2E for multi-room Save/ACK/reload, host promotion and complex split is required before the next beta and tracked in houseplan-e2e#26; CPU validation is not that E2E.

summary.ru: Создание комнат сохраняет точные исходные стены, узлы и проёмы и предлагает все грани после разбиения отрезка.
summary.en: Room creation preserves exact source walls, nodes and openings and offers every face closed by a split segment.
